mettacittānan.g: mettābhāvanāya sampayuttahadaye teneva arahattādhigamena3 iṭṭhādīsu4 tādibhāvappatte uḷāraguṇe.

metti.l: Sakkhi kataṁ hoti, metti saṁsati santhavo
metti.g: sakhibhāvo ca metti ca parisamajjhe santhavo cāti tayā mittaṁ2 kataṁ sādhu hoti laddhakaṁ bhaddakameva.

metādiso.g: pathavitale vā devaloke vā na ca tādiso vaṇṇo aññassa kassaci atthi, yādiso etassa guṇavaṇṇo patthaṭo.
